summary: Dark hero with a diagonal lower edge and a line illustration, then a mix of white and dark sections: benefit tiles, a statement beside a video, three alternating feature rows, a four-step dark strip, press logos on a bright gradient, a photo band with a call card, a review slider, a role card slider and a dark form section.

sections.note: headline with one accent word, paragraph and one pill button left; two line-art characters right; the lower edge is cut diagonally into white
row of four small pale tiles, each with a short coloured lead word, two lines of text and a round dark arrow button at the bottom
large statement with coloured phrases left, rounded video thumbnail with a play button right
three stacked rows that alternate sides: line illustration left with label, heading with accent word, paragraph and outlined button right; then photo right; then illustration left again
small label, left heading, four rounded translucent cards with a numbered bubble, line icon, bold title and a short line
large white rounded card inside the dark section: heading and pink pill button left, wide photo right
on a bright cyan gradient: small label, a dark speech-bubble panel with one large press logo and a quote, then a row of grey press logos
wide angled photo of a person at a desk with a dark card on the left holding a label, short heading and a pink button
cyan gradient ground, heading, pale review cards with a large title, client logo at the top right, star row and quote text, progress bar below
heading with accent word and line left, a horizontal strip of overlapping white role cards each with an icon, title, four job names and a link, progress bar and outlined button below
heading and short line left, cyan rounded form card right with three fields and a dark submit button, followed by a contact card with phone numbers
